item.title: Plane Crash Criticism, Suicide Rise, Bahama Rock
item.ns0:title: Plane Crash Criticism, Suicide Rise, Bahama Rock
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the Commodore of the Royal Bahamas Defense Force fires back against growing criticism over the search and response efforts following a tragic plane crash off Andros that claimed four lives. Finance Minister Michael Halkitis prepares to address Parliament on the controversy surrounding a massive drop in the National Investment Fund, while health officials spotlight an alarming 60 percent surge in suicides across the country. Meanwhile, Bahama Rock workers in Grand Bahama take their fight to the streets over looming layoffs, and wildlife experts investigate a suspected invasive Burmese python sighting in Abaco. Tune in for these top headlines, updates on the teachers' union leadership, and your complete weather forecast.
